mapper.insert: insert into chat_credit_session(user_id, request_id, deducted, deduct_amount, deduct_state, refund_state, retry_count, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{requestId}, #{deducted}, #{deductAmount}, #{deductState}, #{refundState}, 0, now(), now())
mapper.update: update chat_credit_session set refund_state = #{refundState}, retry_count = case when #{refundState} = 'refunded' then 0 else retry_count end, last_error = case when #{refundState} = 'refunded' then null else last_error end, next_retry_time = case when #{refundState} = 'refunded' then null else next_retry_time end, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId} and request_id = #{requestId}

update chat_credit_session set retry_count = retry_count + 1, refund_state = case when refund_state in ('pending', 'refunding') and retry_count + 1 >= #{maxRetry} then 'manual_pending' else refund_state end, deduct_state = case when deduct_state = 'deducting' and retry_count + 1 >= #{maxRetry} then 'manual_pending' else deduct_state end, next_retry_time = case when retry_count + 1 >= #{maxRetry} then null else DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL LEAST(3600, POW(2, retry_count)) SECOND) end, last_error = LEFT(#{lastError}, 512), update_time = now() where id = #{session.id} and (refund_state in ('pending', 'refunding') or deduct_state = 'deducting')
mapper.select: select id, user_id, request_id, deducted, deduct_amount, deduct_state, refund_state, retry_count, last_error, next_retry_time from chat_credit_session where request_id = #{requestId} limit 1

select id, user_id, request_id, deducted, deduct_amount, deduct_state, refund_state, retry_count, last_error, next_retry_time from chat_credit_session where user_id = #{userId} and request_id = #{requestId} limit 1
select count(*) from chat_credit_session where refund_state = 'pending'
select count(*) from chat_credit_session where refund_state = #{state}
select count(*) from chat_credit_session where deduct_state = #{state}
